card.name: Linking words in general web prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted small words (by, such, to, from, in, was) and word pieces in general non-medical web text.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Prepositions and similar words such as by, such, from, in inside ordinary prose.
